To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
intrinsic goals and autonomy supportive learning climates are synergistically effective in improving learning, performance, achievement, and persistence.

the combination of intrinsic goals and autonomy supportive learning environments is more effective than the other three combinations (i.e., extrinsic and autonomy support, intrinsic and controlling, extrinsic and controlling) in promoting students' learning and performance.
the effects of autonomy support and intrinsic goals were additive, and the combined effect on deep processing was significantly greater than the sum of the two main effects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how people's goals and learning environments can interact synergistically in promoting learning.
the question of how to motivate people.
how to motivate students' deep and sustained learning, performance, persistence, and well being.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the synergistic effect is a function of autonomous motivation, and that autonomous motivation is a function of both the intrinsic nature of the goal and the autonomy-supportive context in which the goal is framed.

the synergistic effect of autonomy support on the positive effect of intrinsic goal framing on deep learning and performance was mediated by the effect of autonomy support and intrinsic goal framing on autonomous motivation.

autonomy-supportive learning climates, in combination with intrinsic learning goals, lead to higher quality and quantity of learning, as well as to higher persistence in the learning process, than do controlling learning climates in combination with extrinsic goals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synergistic effects are not only important in terms of the quality of learning and performance, but also in terms of persistence and motivation.
intrinsic goal orientations and autonomy supportive contexts have synergistically positive effects on students' learning, test performance, persistence, and motivation.
the combination of intrinsic goals with autonomy support is the most potent way to promote students' deep processing, performance, and long term persistence in school and college.
The main takeaway from our work is that
both intrinsic goal contents and supportive learning climates are necessary to foster autonomous motivation, which in turn leads to high quality learning, performance, persistence, and enjoyment.
both intrinsic goal contents and autonomous motivation can enhance learning and performance.
the combination of intrinsic goals and autonomy supportive climates yields synergistic benefits for learning, test performance, persistence, and autonomous motivation.
